title: Figma library cleanup: tokens reconciliation, variant consolidation, and publish checklist
creator: Ava Lindstrom
description: Goal: Standardize token usage, prune obsolete component variants, clean auto-layout constraints, and publish a single canonical Figma library that matches the runtime component API. This ticket covers audit, small migrations, documentation updates, and the publish gating checklist. Scope: Buttons, Tables (row/cell variants), Charts (legend + axis styles), and shared tokens (colors, spacing, type). Out of scope: full chart component rewrite and platform SDK changes (separate ENG tickets). Success criteria: 1) No token references to legacy color/spacing tokens in published library pages; 2) Button and Table components reduced to canonical sets (<= 3 size variants each); 3) Auto-layout fixed for row wrap/truncation cases; 4) Release notes and update PRs linked and approved.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Ava L.: Initial audit completed. Found ~28 button variants across pages, many duplicated by boolean property overrides. Chart legends reference two color token sets (legacy-blue / color.primary). Created canonical token mapping doc in Drive.

2026-02-18 - Mateo C.: Began variant consolidation for Button. Strategy: keep primary/secondary/ghost, with size tokens small/medium/large. Converted componentProps to use token aliases (e.g., color.button.primary -> color.brand.600) and added usage notes. Draft PRF (Figma file) saved: https://www.figma.com/file/AbCdEF/Redwood-Design-Library (layer: Button/Consolidation)

2026-02-22 - Design Review: Cross-functional review with PM (Nora Patel) and Frontend (Jamal Ortiz). PM flagged that ghost button must keep original hit area for compliance; Eng requested an accessibility check across contrast ratios. Action: add 4px minimum padding token, verify contrast with color.palette.neutral.800.

2026-02-27 - Mateo C.: Auto-layout fixes applied to DataTable row component: set horizontal spacing to spacing.3 token, min-height bound to token spacing.row-min, and added explicit 'truncate' text behavior for table cells. Noted two legacy instances of manual frames that need manual conversion (files: /legacy/ui-kit/pages).

2026-03-03 - Ava L.: Chart legend variants pruned. Kept: inline, stacked, and collapsed. Replaced legend color tokens with chart.color.<semantic> tokens and documented mapping in the design-system doc (Drive). Added a small note for engineering: prefer 6-color palette for categorical charts (chart.color.setA).

2026-03-06 - Mateo C.: Prepared publish checklist and smoke-test plan. Checklist items: run token audit plugin, validate no orphaned instances, run contrast checks, export component manifest JSON (for SDK), update CHANGELOG, notify Console and Runtime teams. Draft publish timestamp: 2026-03-18 10:00 PST.
2026-03-09 - PM Nora P.: Requested we hold publish until we get one final accessibility pass and a quick integration sanity check from ENG. Created ENG follow-up: ENG-4128 for integration smoke-test.

2026-03-10 - Mateo C.: Integration smoke-test scheduled with Jamal (ENG) on 2026-03-12. Fixed remaining naming inconsistencies (button.primary vs button-filled). Updated release target to 2026-03-20 to allow for fixes if smoke-test surfaces issues.
